## Promoter-centered ATAC x H3K4me3 integration

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(GenomicRanges))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ChIPseeker))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(org.Mm.eg.db))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(clusterProfiler))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

outdir <- "/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/enrichment"
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene

mkgr <- function(f) { x <- read.csv(f); GRanges(x$chr, IRanges(x$start, x$end)) }
gained <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_gained.csv")
lost   <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/DA_peaks_lost.csv")
h3k_g  <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/H3K4me3_gained.csv")
h3k_l  <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/H3K4me3_lost.csv")
h3k_all <- mkgr("/workspace/atac/counts/H3K4me3_regions_all.csv")
```

## 1. ATAC DA peaks: promoter (H3K4me3-marked) vs enhancer (unmarked)

```{r}
cls <- function(gr) {
  f <- rep("Enhancer (H3K4me3-negative)", length(gr))
  f[countOverlaps(gr, h3k_all) > 0] <- "Promoter (H3K4me3-marked)"
  f
}
comp <- rbind(
  data.frame(direction = "Gained in Met", class = cls(gained)),
  data.frame(direction = "Lost in Met", class = cls(lost)))
p <- ggplot(comp, aes(x = direction, fill = class)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", width = 0.55) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Promoter (H3K4me3-marked)" = "#FF9400",
                               "Enhancer (H3K4me3-negative)" = "#0279EE"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of DA peaks",
       title = "ATAC DA peaks: H3K4me3-marked promoters vs enhancers") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "ATAC_DA_promoter_vs_enhancer_H3K4me3.svg"), p, width = 6, height = 4.5)
print(table(comp$direction, comp$class))
```

## 2. Promoter classes: accessibility x H3K4me3 change

```{r}
# promoters = +/-2kb TSS
prom <- promoters(txdb, upstream = 2000, downstream = 2000)
prom <- reduce(prom)
std <- paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))
prom <- prom[as.character(seqnames(prom)) %in% std]
# map each promoter to nearest gene (annoDb triggers an org.db coercion bug
# in this ChIPseeker version; map symbols manually afterwards)
ann_prom <- annotatePeak(prom, tssRegion = c(-2000, 2000), TxDb = txdb, level = "gene")
ann_df <- as.data.frame(ann_prom)
sym_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(ann_df$geneId),
                                 keytype = "ENTREZID", columns = "SYMBOL")
sym_map <- sym_map[!duplicated(sym_map$ENTREZID), ]
ann_df$SYMBOL <- sym_map$SYMBOL[match(as.character(ann_df$geneId), sym_map$ENTREZID)]
prom_gr <- prom
gene_id <- ann_df$geneId
gene_sym <- ann_df$SYMBOL

acc_g <- countOverlaps(prom_gr, gained) > 0
acc_l <- countOverlaps(prom_gr, lost) > 0
h3g   <- countOverlaps(prom_gr, h3k_g) > 0
h3l   <- countOverlaps(prom_gr, h3k_l) > 0

prom_class <- rep("No change", length(prom_gr))
prom_class[acc_g & !acc_l] <- "Accessibility gained"
prom_class[acc_l & !acc_g] <- "Accessibility lost"
prom_class[acc_g & acc_l]  <- "Mixed accessibility"
# refine with H3K4me3
prom_class[acc_g & h3g] <- "Activated promoter (acc+ H3K4me3+)"
prom_class[acc_l & h3l] <- "Repressed promoter (acc- H3K4me3-)"
prom_class[acc_g & h3l] <- "Primed enhancer-like (acc+ H3K4me3-)"
prom_class[acc_l & h3g] <- "Poised (acc- H3K4me3+)"

res_prom <- data.frame(chr = seqnames(prom_gr), start = start(prom_gr), end = end(prom_gr),
                       geneId = gene_id, SYMBOL = gene_sym, class = prom_class)
write.csv(res_prom, file.path(outdir, "promoter_integration_classes.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
print(table(prom_class))
```

## 4. Integration visualizations: Venn diagrams + quadrant scatter

```{r}
prom <- read.csv("/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/enrichment/promoter_integration_classes.csv")
atac <- readRDS("/workspace/atac/counts/dds_obj.rds")
ct   <- readRDS("/workspace/atac/counts/ct_dds_obj.rds")

mkgr <- function(df) GRanges(df$chr, IRanges(df$start, df$end))
prom_gr <- mkgr(prom)
atac_res <- atac$res; ct_res <- ct$res
atac_gr <- mkgr(atac_res); ct_gr <- mkgr(ct_res)

# per-promoter log2FC + padj from overlapping consensus peak/region (max |log2FC|)
pick_lfc <- function(prom_gr, res_gr, lfc, padj) {
  out_lfc <- rep(NA_real_, length(prom_gr))
  out_p <- rep(NA_real_, length(prom_gr))
  hits <- findOverlaps(prom_gr, res_gr)
  if (length(hits)) {
    d <- data.frame(q = queryHits(hits), lfc = lfc[subjectHits(hits)],
                    p = padj[subjectHits(hits)])
    d$abs <- abs(d$lfc)
    best <- d[order(d$q, -d$abs), ]
    best <- best[!duplicated(best$q), ]
    out_lfc[best$q] <- best$lfc
    out_p[best$q] <- best$p
  }
  list(lfc = out_lfc, padj = out_p)
}
a <- pick_lfc(prom_gr, atac_gr, atac_res$log2FoldChange, atac_res$padj)
c_ <- pick_lfc(prom_gr, ct_gr, ct_res$log2FoldChange, ct_res$padj)
prom$atac_lfc <- a$lfc; prom$atac_padj <- a$padj
prom$h3k_lfc <- c_$lfc; prom$h3k_padj <- c_$padj
```

## 6. Quadrant scatter (significance-aware: DA = FDR<0.05 & |FC|>2)

```{r}
d <- prom[!is.na(prom$atac_lfc) & !is.na(prom$h3k_lfc), ]
da_a <- !is.na(d$atac_padj) & d$atac_padj < 0.05 & abs(d$atac_lfc) > 1
da_h <- !is.na(d$h3k_padj) & d$h3k_padj < 0.05 & abs(d$h3k_lfc) > 1
d$quad <- "Not significant"
d$quad[da_a & da_h & d$atac_lfc > 0 & d$h3k_lfc > 0] <- "Activated (acc+ H3K4me3+)"
d$quad[da_a & da_h & d$atac_lfc < 0 & d$h3k_lfc < 0] <- "Repressed (acc- H3K4me3-)"
d$quad[da_a & d$atac_lfc > 0 & !(da_h & d$h3k_lfc > 0)] <- "Accessibility gained only"
d$quad[da_a & d$atac_lfc < 0 & !(da_h & d$h3k_lfc < 0)] <- "Accessibility lost only"
d$quad[!da_a & da_h & d$h3k_lfc > 0] <- "H3K4me3 gained only"
d$quad[!da_a & da_h & d$h3k_lfc < 0] <- "H3K4me3 lost only"
cat("quadrant counts (promoters with both measurements):", nrow(d), "\n")
print(table(d$quad))

pal <- c("Activated (acc+ H3K4me3+)" = "#FF9400", "Repressed (acc- H3K4me3-)" = "#0279EE",
         "Accessibility gained only" = "#75A025", "Accessibility lost only" = "#0279EE",
         "H3K4me3 gained only" = "#FD9BED", "H3K4me3 lost only" = "#E9ED4C",
         "Not significant" = "grey85")
p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = atac_lfc, y = h3k_lfc, color = quad)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  scale_color_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "ATAC accessibility change (log2FC, Met vs Normal)",
       y = "H3K4me3 change (log2FC, Met vs Normal)",
       title = "Promoter-level integration: accessibility vs H3K4me3") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 9))
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "INT_quadrant_promoters.svg"), p, width = 8.5, height = 6)

write.csv(d[, c("chr","start","end","SYMBOL","class","atac_lfc","h3k_lfc","quad")],
          file.path(outdir, "INT_promoter_quadrant_table.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 7.marker_heatmap

```{r}
# Per-sample promoter signals (ATAC + H3K4me3) for the 18 RNA-seq marker genes.
# Promoter = consensus peaks within +/-2 kb of the gene TSS (TxDb mm10).
# Values: log2 size-factor-normalized counts, z-scored per row.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2); library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize); library(svglite)
  library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene); library(org.Mm.eg.db); library(AnnotationDbi)
})
setwd("/workspace/atac")
outdir <- "/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/RNA_crosscheck"

mk <- read.csv(file.path(outdir, "RNA_marker_DE.csv"))
markers <- mk$SYMBOL

# TSS per marker from TxDb
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
eg <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = markers, keytype = "SYMBOL", columns = "ENTREZID")
eg <- eg[!duplicated(eg$SYMBOL), ]
g <- genes(txdb)
g <- g[g$gene_id %in% eg$ENTREZID]
mtoeg <- setNames(eg$ENTREZID, eg$SYMBOL)

tss_df <- data.frame(chr = seqnames(g), gene_id = as.character(g$gene_id), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tss_df$SYMBOL <- names(mtoeg)[match(tss_df$gene_id, mtoeg)]
tss_df <- tss_df[tss_df$SYMBOL %in% markers, ]

get_z <- function(obj_path, label) {
  d <- readRDS(obj_path); dd <- d$dds; pk <- d$peaks
  gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(pk$CHR, IRanges::IRanges(pk$START, pk$END))
  tg <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(tss_df$chr, IRanges::IRanges(rep(0, nrow(tss_df)), rep(0, nrow(tss_df))), gene = tss_df$SYMBOL)
  # promoter window per gene: use genes() TSS +/- 2kb
  gp <- promoters(g, upstream = 2000, downstream = 2000)
  hits <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(gr, gp)
  qh <- data.frame(peak = queryHits(hits), gene_id = as.character(gp$gene_id[subjectHits(hits)]))
  qh$SYMBOL <- names(mtoeg)[match(qh$gene_id, mtoeg)]
  qh <- qh[qh$SYMBOL %in% markers, ]
  # one peak per gene: strongest absolute DESeq2 result if available, else highest count
  qh$count <- rowSums(counts(dd, normalized = TRUE)[qh$peak, ])
  qh <- qh[order(-qh$count), ]
  sel <- qh[!duplicated(qh$SYMBOL), ]
  cat(label, "genes with promoter peak:", nrow(sel), "/", length(markers), "\n")
  mat <- log2(counts(dd, normalized = TRUE)[sel$peak, ] + 1)
  mat <- t(scale(t(mat))); mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
  rownames(mat) <- sel$SYMBOL
  mat
}
zA <- get_z("counts/dds_obj.rds", "ATAC")
zH <- get_z("counts/ct_dds_obj.rds", "H3K4me3")

# ---- (item 2) per-sample normalized counts CSV for all 18 markers ----
# wide format: one row per gene x assay (strongest promoter peak), one column per sample
get_counts_wide <- function(obj_path, assay_name) {
  d <- readRDS(obj_path); dd <- d$dds; pk <- d$peaks
  gp0 <- promoters(g, upstream = 2000, downstream = 2000)
  h0 <- GenomicRanges::findOverlaps(
    GenomicRanges::GRanges(pk$CHR, IRanges::IRanges(pk$START, pk$END)), gp0)
  q0 <- data.frame(peak = queryHits(h0),
                   SYMBOL = names(mtoeg)[match(as.character(gp0$gene_id[subjectHits(h0)]), mtoeg)])
  q0 <- q0[q0$SYMBOL %in% markers, ]
  q0 <- q0[order(-rowSums(counts(dd, normalized = TRUE)[q0$peak, ])), ]
  q0 <- q0[!duplicated(q0$SYMBOL), ]
  m0 <- counts(dd, normalized = TRUE)[q0$peak, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(m0) <- q0$SYMBOL
  df <- as.data.frame(m0)
  df$SYMBOL <- rownames(df); df$assay <- assay_name
  df
}
cnt_w <- rbind(
  get_counts_wide("counts/dds_obj.rds", "ATAC-seq"),
  get_counts_wide("counts/ct_dds_obj.rds", "H3K4me3 CUT&Tag"))
cnt_w <- merge(cnt_w, mk[, c("SYMBOL", "class")], by = "SYMBOL", all.x = TRUE)
write.csv(cnt_w, file.path(outdir, "RNA_marker_promoter_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("counts CSV saved:", nrow(cnt_w), "rows\n")

samp_order <- c("N1","N3","N4","N6","Met1","Met3","Met4","Met6")
zA <- zA[, samp_order]; zH <- zH[, samp_order]
cls <- setNames(mk$class, mk$SYMBOL)
# Combined matrix: ATAC block on top, H3K4me3 block below, NA-padded, rows aligned
allg <- union(rownames(zA), rownames(zH))
zA2 <- zA[intersect(allg, rownames(zA)), ]; zH2 <- zH[intersect(allg, rownames(zH)), ]
padA <- matrix(NA, length(allg) - nrow(zA2), ncol(zA2), dimnames = list(setdiff(allg, rownames(zA2)), colnames(zA2)))
padH <- matrix(NA, length(allg) - nrow(zH2), ncol(zH2), dimnames = list(setdiff(allg, rownames(zH2)), colnames(zH2)))
zA2 <- rbind(zA2, padA)[allg, ]; zH2 <- rbind(zH2, padH)[allg, ]
comb <- rbind(zA2, zH2)
assay <- factor(rep(c("ATAC", "H3K4me3"), each = length(allg)), levels = c("ATAC", "H3K4me3"))
row_cls <- cls[allg]
row_cls[is.na(row_cls)] <- "none"
col_cls <- c(sinusoidal_down = "#0279EE", capillarized_up = "#FF9400", inflammation_up = "#FD9BED", none = "grey80")
row_cls_comb <- rep(row_cls, 2)
ha_row <- rowAnnotation(class = row_cls_comb, col = list(class = col_cls), annotation_name_side = "top")
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#0279EE", "#FAF9F3", "#FF9400"))
cs <- factor(c(rep("Normal", 4), rep("Met", 4)), levels = c("Normal", "Met"))

ht <- Heatmap(comb, name = "z", col = col_fun, cluster_columns = FALSE,
              cluster_rows = FALSE, row_split = assay,
              row_title = c("ATAC-seq", "H3K4me3 CUT&Tag"),
              column_split = cs, column_title = "Marker-gene promoter signals",
              border = TRUE, na_col = "grey95",
              right_annotation = ha_row,
              row_title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
              row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 8), show_row_names = TRUE)

svg("/workspace/atac/qc/INT_marker_promoter_heatmap.svg", width = 9, height = 8)
draw(ht, merge_legends = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

## 8.Deeptool profile

```{r}
# 28_deeptools_style_heatmap.R
# deepTools-style metagene heatmaps of chromatin-accessibility and H3K4me3
# CHANGES (Met - Normal, delta log2 CPM per bin) across the whole gene:
# 3 kb upstream of the TSS (5'UTR start) -> gene body (TSS to 3'UTR/gene end,
# scaled) -> 3 kb downstream. Rows = genes, grouped by RNA direction
# (top 500 RNA-up / top 500 RNA-down; nominal p<0.05, |log2FC|>1, ranked by p;
# no gene passes FDR<0.05 in this cohort, min FDR = 0.071).
# Output: RNA_crosscheck/INT_deeptools_style_*.{svg,csv}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges); library(Rsamtools); library(IRanges)
  library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene); library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize)
  library(grid); library(ggplot2)
})
setwd("/workspace/atac")
outdir <- "/mnt/results/atac_vessel_analysis/RNA_crosscheck"
qcdir  <- "/workspace/atac/qc"
FLANK <- 3000L; N_FLANK_BIN <- 30L; N_BODY_BIN <- 100L   # 100 bp flank bins
N_BIN <- 2 * N_FLANK_BIN + N_BODY_BIN                     # 160 columns

## ---- 1. RNA gene sets ----------------------------------------------------
de <- read.csv(file.path(outdir, "RNA_EC_DE_all_genes.csv"))
up_cand <- de[de$RNA_p < 0.05 & de$RNA_log2FC > 1, ]
dn_cand <- de[de$RNA_p < 0.05 & de$RNA_log2FC < -1, ]
up <- up_cand[order(up_cand$RNA_p), "SYMBOL"][1:500]
dn <- dn_cand[order(dn_cand$RNA_p), "SYMBOL"][1:500]
cat("RNA-up genes:", length(up), " RNA-down genes:", length(dn), "\n")

## ---- 2. Gene regions: TSS-3kb .. gene-end+3kb ----------------------------
txdb <- TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
g <- genes(txdb)
sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(g$gene_id),
                             keytype = "ENTREZID", columns = "SYMBOL")
sym <- sym[!duplicated(sym$ENTREZID), ]
g$symbol <- sym$SYMBOL[match(as.character(g$gene_id), sym$ENTREZID)]
g <- g[!is.na(g$symbol) & as.character(seqnames(g)) %in% paste0("chr", c(1:19, "X", "Y"))]
# keep longest gene body per symbol
gdf <- as.data.frame(g); gdf$width_ <- width(g)
gdf <- gdf[order(gdf$symbol, -gdf$width_), ]; gdf <- gdf[!duplicated(gdf$symbol), ]
g <- GRanges(gdf$seqnames, IRanges(gdf$start, gdf$end), strand = gdf$strand,
             gene_id = gdf$gene_id, symbol = gdf$symbol)

mk_region <- function(gr) {
  tss <- ifelse(as.character(strand(gr)) == "-", end(gr), start(gr))
  gend <- ifelse(as.character(strand(gr)) == "-", start(gr), end(gr))
  GRanges(seqnames(gr), IRanges(pmax(1, pmin(tss, gend) - FLANK),
                                pmax(tss, gend) + FLANK),
          strand = strand(gr), symbol = gr$symbol, tss = tss, gend = gend)
}
sel <- g[g$symbol %in% c(up, dn)]
reg <- mk_region(sel)
reg <- reg[width(reg) > 2 * FLANK + 10]   # need a gene body
cat("genes with usable regions:", length(reg),
    " (up", sum(reg$symbol %in% up), "/ down", sum(reg$symbol %in% dn),
    "; unmapped candidates are mostly uncharacterized Gm loci absent from TxDb)\n")

## ---- 3. Bins: 30x100bp upstream | 100 scaled body | 30x100bp downstream ---
mk_bins <- function(i) {
  r <- reg[i]; plus <- as.character(strand(r)) != "-"
  tss <- r$tss; gend <- r$gend
  # oriented (5'->3') coordinate space: o(x) = x on + strand, -x on - strand
  o <- function(v) if (plus) v else -v
  inv <- function(a, b) if (plus) c(a, b) else c(-b, -a)  # oriented [a,b] -> genomic start/end
  tss_o <- o(tss); gend_o <- o(gend)   # tss_o < gend_o always
  ab <- rbind(
    t(sapply(0:(N_FLANK_BIN - 1), function(k)
      inv(tss_o - FLANK + k * (FLANK / N_FLANK_BIN),
          tss_o - FLANK + (k + 1) * (FLANK / N_FLANK_BIN)))),
    t(sapply(1:N_BODY_BIN, function(k)
      inv(seq(tss_o, gend_o, length.out = N_BODY_BIN + 1)[k],
          seq(tss_o, gend_o, length.out = N_BODY_BIN + 1)[k + 1]))),
    t(sapply(0:(N_FLANK_BIN - 1), function(k)
      inv(gend_o + k * (FLANK / N_FLANK_BIN),
          gend_o + (k + 1) * (FLANK / N_FLANK_BIN)))))
  colnames(ab) <- c("s", "e")
  ab <- as.data.frame(ab); ab$s <- pmax(1, ab$s)
  ab$e[ab$e < ab$s] <- ab$s[ab$e < ab$s]   # guard zero-width body bins
  data.frame(chr = as.character(seqnames(r)), start = ab$s, end = ab$e,
             gene_i = i, bin_i = 1:N_BIN,
             part = rep(c("upstream", "body", "downstream"),
                        times = c(N_FLANK_BIN, N_BODY_BIN, N_FLANK_BIN)),
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
bdf <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(length(reg)), mk_bins))
bins <- GRanges(bdf$chr, IRanges(bdf$start, bdf$end),
                gene_i = bdf$gene_i, bin_i = bdf$bin_i, part = bdf$part)
cat("total bins:", length(bins), "\n")

## ---- 4. Per-BAM bin counts (read starts in restricted regions) -----------
bams <- c(sprintf("/mnt/user-uploads/ATAC/ATAC_%s_clean.bam",
                  c("N1","N3","N4","N6","Met1","Met3","Met4","Met6")),
          sprintf("/mnt/user-uploads/H3K4me3/CUT_%s_clean.bam",
                  c("N1","N3","N4","N6","Met1","Met3","Met4","Met6")))
samp <- c("ATAC_N1","ATAC_N3","ATAC_N4","ATAC_N6","ATAC_Met1","ATAC_Met3","ATAC_Met4","ATAC_Met6",
          "H3K_N1","H3K_N3","H3K_N4","H3K_N6","H3K_Met1","H3K_Met3","H3K_Met4","H3K_Met6")

# per-chromosome bin spans for restricted scanning
chroms <- unique(as.character(seqnames(bins)))
count_bam <- function(bf) {
  stats <- idxstatsBam(bf); libsize <- sum(stats$mapped)
  cnt <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(reg), ncol = N_BIN)
  for (ch in chroms) {
    b_ch <- bins[as.character(seqnames(bins)) == ch]
    span <- range(b_ch)
    sbp <- ScanBamParam(which = span,
                        flag = scanBamFlag(isUnmappedQuery = FALSE),
                        what = "pos")
    x <- scanBam(bf, param = sbp)[[1]]$pos
    if (!length(x)) next
    # per-base coverage of read starts; sum over each bin (handles overlapping bins)
    cov <- coverage(IRanges(x, width = 1))
    if (max(end(b_ch)) > length(cov))
      cov <- c(cov, Rle(0L, max(end(b_ch)) - length(cov)))
    cnts <- viewSums(Views(cov, start = start(b_ch), end = end(b_ch)))
    i <- cbind(b_ch$gene_i, b_ch$bin_i)
    cnt[i] <- cnt[i] + as.integer(cnts)
  }
  list(cnt = cnt, libsize = libsize)
}

res_cache <- "counts/bin_counts_28.rds"
if (file.exists(res_cache)) {
  cat("loading cached bin counts...\n"); res <- readRDS(res_cache)
} else {
  res <- lapply(seq_along(bams), function(i) {
    cat("processing", samp[i], "...\n"); flush.console()
    count_bam(bams[i])
  })
  names(res) <- samp
  saveRDS(res, res_cache)
}
lib <- sapply(res, `[[`, "libsize")
cat("library sizes (mapped reads):", paste(lib, collapse = ", "), "\n")

## ---- 5. delta log2 CPM (Met - Normal) per gene per bin -------------------
# gene x bin x sample array of log2 CPM
lcpm <- sapply(samp, function(s) log2(res[[s]]$cnt / res[[s]]$libsize * 1e6 + 1),
               simplify = "array")
dA <- rowMeans(lcpm[, , grep("^ATAC_Met", samp)], dims = 2) -
      rowMeans(lcpm[, , grep("^ATAC_N", samp)], dims = 2)
dH <- rowMeans(lcpm[, , grep("^H3K_Met", samp)], dims = 2) -
      rowMeans(lcpm[, , grep("^H3K_N", samp)], dims = 2)
rownames(dA) <- rownames(dH) <- reg$symbol
# flip minus-strand genes to 5'->3' orientation (bins were built in oriented space)
minus <- as.character(strand(reg)) == "-"
cat("minus-strand genes flipped:", sum(minus), "of", length(reg), "\n")
if (any(minus)) {
  dA[minus, ] <- dA[minus, N_BIN:1]
  dH[minus, ] <- dH[minus, N_BIN:1]
}

gi_up <- match(up, reg$symbol); gi_up <- gi_up[!is.na(gi_up)]
gi_dn <- match(dn, reg$symbol); gi_dn <- gi_dn[!is.na(gi_dn)]
ord <- c(gi_up, gi_dn)
rowgrp <- factor(rep(c("RNA-upregulated", "RNA-downregulated"),
                     c(length(gi_up), length(gi_dn))),
                 levels = c("RNA-upregulated", "RNA-downregulated"))
cat("rows in heatmap:", length(ord), " (up", length(gi_up), "/ down", length(gi_dn), ")\n")

## ---- 6. deepTools-style heatmaps ----------------------------------------
col_fun <- colorRamp2(seq(-1, 1, length.out = 11), rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu")))
lab <- c("-3 kb", rep("", N_FLANK_BIN - 1), "TSS", rep("", N_BODY_BIN - 2),
         "3'end", rep("", N_FLANK_BIN - 1), "+3 kb")
csp <- rep(c("3 kb upstream", "gene body (scaled)", "3 kb downstream"),
           times = c(N_FLANK_BIN, N_BODY_BIN, N_FLANK_BIN))
ha_col <- HeatmapAnnotation(df = data.frame(part = csp), show_legend = FALSE,
                            col = list(part = c("3 kb upstream" = "#ECE9E2",
                                                "gene body (scaled)" = "#E9ED4C",
                                                "3 kb downstream" = "#FAF9F3")),
                            annotation_name_side = "left")

draw_hm <- function(mat, title, fname) {
  ht <- Heatmap(mat[ord, ], name = "d log2 CPM\n(Met - Normal)", col = col_fun,
                cluster_columns = FALSE, cluster_rows = FALSE,
                show_row_names = FALSE, top_annotation = ha_col,
                column_labels = lab, column_title = title,
                column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
                row_split = rowgrp, row_title = c("RNA-upregulated", "RNA-downregulated"),
                row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
                border = TRUE, use_raster = TRUE, raster_quality = 4)
  svg(file.path(qcdir, fname), width = 9, height = 7.5); draw(ht); dev.off()
}
draw_hm(dA, "ATAC-seq accessibility change (Met - Normal)", "INT_deeptools_style_ATAC_RNAgenes.svg")
draw_hm(dH, "H3K4me3 CUT&Tag change (Met - Normal)", "INT_deeptools_style_H3K4me3_RNAgenes.svg")

## ---- 7. mean profile curves + standard error bands ------------------------
# per-bin Wilcoxon p (RNA-up vs RNA-down) kept in the CSV for reference
wilcox_pbin <- function(mat) {
  sapply(1:N_BIN, function(b)
    suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(mat[gi_up, b], mat[gi_dn, b])$p.value))
}
pA <- wilcox_pbin(dA); pH <- wilcox_pbin(dH)
se <- function(mat, idx) colMeans(mat[idx, ]) * 0 +
  apply(mat[idx, ], 2, function(v) sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(length(v)))
prof <- data.frame(bin = 1:N_BIN,
                   ATAC_up = colMeans(dA[gi_up, ]), ATAC_up_se = se(dA, gi_up),
                   ATAC_dn = colMeans(dA[gi_dn, ]), ATAC_dn_se = se(dA, gi_dn),
                   H3K_up = colMeans(dH[gi_up, ]), H3K_up_se = se(dH, gi_up),
                   H3K_dn = colMeans(dH[gi_dn, ]), H3K_dn_se = se(dH, gi_dn),
                   ATAC_p = pA, H3K_p = pH)
write.csv(prof, file.path(qcdir, "INT_deeptools_style_mean_profiles.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
pl <- rbind(
  setNames(cbind(prof[, c("bin", "ATAC_up", "ATAC_up_se", "ATAC_p")],
                 data.frame(assay = "ATAC-seq", grp = "RNA-up")),
           c("bin", "delta", "se", "pval", "assay", "grp")),
  setNames(cbind(prof[, c("bin", "H3K_up", "H3K_up_se", "H3K_p")],
                 data.frame(assay = "H3K4me3 CUT&Tag", grp = "RNA-up")),
           c("bin", "delta", "se", "pval", "assay", "grp")),
  setNames(cbind(prof[, c("bin", "ATAC_dn", "ATAC_dn_se", "ATAC_p")],
                 data.frame(assay = "ATAC-seq", grp = "RNA-down")),
           c("bin", "delta", "se", "pval", "assay", "grp")),
  setNames(cbind(prof[, c("bin", "H3K_dn", "H3K_dn_se", "H3K_p")],
                 data.frame(assay = "H3K4me3 CUT&Tag", grp = "RNA-down")),
           c("bin", "delta", "se", "pval", "assay", "grp")))
pl$assay <- factor(pl$assay, levels = c("ATAC-seq", "H3K4me3 CUT&Tag"))
pl$grp <- factor(pl$grp, levels = c("RNA-up", "RNA-down"))
p <- ggplot(pl, aes(bin, delta, color = grp, fill = grp)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = delta - se, ymax = delta + se, color = NULL),
              alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + facet_wrap(~assay, ncol = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("RNA-up" = "#FF9400", "RNA-down" = "#0279EE"), name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("RNA-up" = "#FF9400", "RNA-down" = "#0279EE"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, N_FLANK_BIN, N_FLANK_BIN + N_BODY_BIN / 2,
                                N_FLANK_BIN + N_BODY_BIN, N_BIN),
                     labels = c("-3 kb", "TSS", "body", "3'end", "+3 kb")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean d log2 CPM (Met - Normal)",
       subtitle = "Shaded band: mean +/- SEM across genes") +
  theme_classic(base_family = "Liberation Sans") + theme(legend.position = "top")
ggsave(file.path(qcdir, "INT_deeptools_style_profiles.svg"), p, width = 7, height = 5.4)
```
